about_the_game:
Character: George the Red Lizard for Lizards Must Die 2, this is a DLC that will give you access to a powerful new character!

Have you dreamed of playing as a lizard for a long time? Here is your great opportunity! George is a cowboy who was the first to defect to the Russ in the great war for Hyperborea between the Russ and the Lizards. Unleash the power of your wrench and shotgun on your enemies, as well as use new unique abilities. George is a specialist in throwing grenades, shooting at close range and luring enemies to his side, try new strategies to complete the game playing as the RED LIZARD.

George got the ammo from the warehouse and is ready to fight against the green lizards!
